name: Hypertension: sodium ceiling
rationale: Keep sodium to no more than 2,300 mg a day.
source_locator: 2025 AHA/ACC multi-society guideline for the prevention, detection, evaluation and management of high blood pressure in adults. DRAFT: values taken from secondary summaries (StatPearls NBK482514, AHA statement Circ Res 2021 Table 4); primary guideline text NOT read.

name: Hypertension: sodium target 1,500 mg
rationale: An ideal sodium intake for people with high blood pressure is below 1,500 mg a day; any reduction helps.
source_locator: 2025 AHA/ACC multi-society guideline for the prevention, detection, evaluation and management of high blood pressure in adults. DRAFT: values taken from secondary summaries (StatPearls NBK482514, AHA statement Circ Res 2021 Table 4); primary guideline text NOT read.

name: Hypertension (normal kidney function): potassium from food
rationale: For people with high blood pressure and normal kidney function, 3,500 to 5,000 mg of potassium a day from food can help lower blood pressure.
source_locator: 2025 AHA/ACC multi-society guideline for the prevention, detection, evaluation and management of high blood pressure in adults. DRAFT: values taken from secondary summaries (StatPearls NBK482514, AHA statement Circ Res 2021 Table 4); primary guideline text NOT read. Not for CKD or conditions needing potassium monitoring. REVIEW: ACE inhibitor/ARB or potassium-sparing diuretic use raises hyperkalaemia risk; no source read for this.

name: Hypertension: ICMR-NIN added salt limit
rationale: Indian dietary guidelines advise no more than 5 g of added salt a day (about 2,000 mg of sodium).
source_locator: ICMR-NIN Dietary Guidelines for Indians 2024 (guideline on restricting salt). Text read via vikaspedia reproduction; the same text also cites 2,300 mg sodium, so the two figures are not consistent. Kept advisory.

name: Hypertension: DASH-style eating pattern
rationale: A DASH-style pattern (fruit, vegetables, whole grains, low-fat dairy) lowers blood pressure.
source_locator: 2025 AHA/ACC multi-society guideline for the prevention, detection, evaluation and management of high blood pressure in adults. DRAFT: values taken from secondary summaries (StatPearls NBK482514, AHA statement Circ Res 2021 Table 4); primary guideline text NOT read.
